Theorem
[Closed Subgroup Theorem] ↗ prop:properties-of-lie-group-exponential-map 1. chC:C.8

Suppose $G$ is a Lie group and $H \subseteq G$ is a subgroup in the algebraic sense. Then $H$ is an embedded Lie subgroup of $G$ if and only if it is closed in the topological sense.

An important special case of the closed subgroup theorem is that of a discrete subgroup, that is, a subgroup that is discrete in the subspace topology.
